I took 140/3 from the round-4 reviewer and propagated it into five agent briefs, overriding my own earlier measurement that main is green under `dune test --root .`. The PR's real value is unchanged and narrower: /tmp/dune-project exists (verified, (lang dune 3.0), 3 Sept) and dune walks to the OUTERMOST ancestor, so unrooted dune calls reroot; the pcc: failures appear under DIRECT BINARY INVOCATION, not under `dune test --root .`. Note also that `dune test --root .` without --force can exit 0 having run nothing, which is section 10.4 and is a candidate explanation for how the two counts diverged.
